name: Friederike Charlotte of Hesse-Darmstadt
role: Princess of Hesse-Darmstadt and of Hesse-Kassel
contribution: A princess of Hesse-Darmstadt and through her marriage a princess of Hesse-Kassel.

checks.lead: Friederike Charlotte of Hessen-Darmstadt (8 September 1698 Darmstadt – 22 March 1777, Darmstadt) was a princess of Hesse-Darmstadt and through her marriage a princess of Hesse-Kassel.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
